title: Coherent formal modules on an affine Noetherian scheme are finite modules over the completion
statement: Let $A$ be a Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], $I\subseteq A$ an ideal, $A^\wedge=\varprojlim_nA/I^n$ the $I$-adic completion [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion], $X=\operatorname{Spec}A$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] and $\mathcal I=\widetilde I\subseteq\mathcal O_X$ the quasi-coherent sheaf of ideals associated to $I$ [lem-weil-pbc-spec-module-tilde-sections]; for an $A^\wedge$-module $M$ write $I^nM$ for $(IA^\wedge)^nM$ (the $A$-submodule generated by the $am$, $a\in I^n$). (1) Let $(\mathcal F_n)$ be an object of $\mathit{Coh}(X,\mathcal I)$ [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module] and $M=\varprojlim_n\Gamma(X,\mathcal F_n)$ (limit along the maps induced by the transition maps), an $A^\wedge$-module by $(a_n)_n\cdot(x_n)_n=(a_nx_n)_n$ ($a_n\in A/I^n$ acts on $\Gamma(X,\mathcal F_n)$ since $\mathcal I^n\mathcal F_n=0$). Then $M$ is a finitely generated $A^\wedge$-module, and for every $n\ge1$ the projection $p_n:M\to\Gamma(X,\mathcal F_n)$ is surjective with kernel $I^nM$. (2) The functor $E:(\mathcal F_n)\mapsto\varprojlim_n\Gamma(X,\mathcal F_n)$, $(\alpha_n)\mapsto\varprojlim_n\Gamma(X,\alpha_n)$, is an equivalence of categories from $\mathit{Coh}(X,\mathcal I)$ onto the category of finitely generated $A^\wedge$-modules and $A^\wedge$-linear maps; a quasi-inverse sends $M$ to $\big((M/I^nM)^\sim\big)_{n\ge1}$ with the canonical surjections as transition maps.

proof.text: Construct L and p with the limiting cones, naturality, projection kernels and completed scalar action by the finite-limit construction (original steps 1 and 3-5). This step asserts no equivalence.

Use the actual lifted canonical quotient functor Q defined by the quotient-coherence theorem. Apply finite-module completeness to L and p, using the IsLimit, naturality and scalar hypotheses, to obtain epsilon: Q followed by L is naturally isomorphic to identity.
Apply reconstruction to L and p, using naturality and the surjective ideal-power kernel assertions, to obtain eta: L followed by Q is naturally isomorphic to identity.

Apply CategoryTheory.Equivalence.mk to L, Q, eta.symm and epsilon. This adjusts the unit to satisfy the triangle law while keeping the two functors definitionally unchanged. Therefore p and all four of its assertions remain the desired ones for E.functor=L. Since Q is literally ObjectProperty.lift of the canonical sheaf quotient functor, Q followed by the coherent full-subcategory inclusion is definitionally that functor. Iso.refl supplies the last inverse-identification assertion.

Split into 7 steps following the Stacks proof: (1)-(2) reduction from Coh(X,I~) to inverse systems of finite A-modules via Gamma and tilde (existing nodes: 01XZ pqf-lem-coherent-ft-locnoeth, finite-type-affine, tilde/Gamma adjunction, ideal-times sections); (3) generators by Nakayama for the nilpotent ideal I/I^n (lem-weil-pbc-nakayama-nilpotent, 00DV (11)); (4) kernels with surjective transitions and the Mittag-Leffler exactness (new node lem-weil-pbc-tower-limit-exact-surjective-kernels, Algebra 03CA / Homology 02N1), giving M finite over A^; (5) M/I^nM = M_n via 05GG (lem-weil-pbc-module-completion-complete); (6) the quasi-inverse N -> (N/I^nN) and completeness of finite modules over the Noetherian complete ring A^ (new node lem-weil-pbc-finite-module-complete-over-complete-noetherian, Algebra 00MA (3)/031B; lem-weil-pbc-adic-completion-noetherian 0316); (7) assembly of the equivalence. stmt_deps kept. lean.statement: theorem coherentFormalModules_affine (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] (I : Ideal A) (J : (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)).IdealSheafData) (hJ : J = Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop (I.map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of A)).inv.hom)) : ∃ E : CoherentFormalModule (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)) J ≌ ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory (fun N : ModuleCat.{u} (AdicCompletion I A) ↦ Module.Finite (AdicCompletion I A) N), ∃ p : ∀ F : CoherentFormalModule (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)) J, (Functor.const ℕᵒᵖ).obj ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars (algebraMap A (AdicCompletion I A))).obj (E.functor.obj F).obj) ⟶ F.obj ⋙ moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of A), (∀ F, Nonempty (IsLimit (Cone.mk _ (p F)))) ∧ (∀ (F G : CoherentFormalModule (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)) J) (f : F ⟶ G) (n : ℕ), (ModuleCat.restrictScalars (algebraMap A (AdicCompletion I A))).map (E.functor.map f).hom ≫ (p G).app (op n) = (p F).app (op n) ≫ (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of A)).map (f.hom.app (op n))) ∧ (∀ (F : CoherentFormalModule (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)) J) (n : ℕ), Function.Surjective ((p F).app (op n)) ∧ LinearMap.ker ((p F).app (op n)).hom = I ^ (n + 1) • (⊤ : Submodule A ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars (algebraMap A (AdicCompletion I A))).obj (E.functor.obj F).obj))) ∧ (∀ (F : CoherentFormalModule (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)) J) (n : ℕ) (r : AdicCompletion I A) (a : A) (x : (E.functor.obj F).obj), AdicCompletion.evalₐ I (n + 1) r = Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1)) a → (p F).app (op n) (r • x) = a • (p F).app (op n) x) ∧ Nonempty (E.inverse ⋙ ObjectProperty.ι (IsCoherentFormalModule J) ≅ ObjectProperty.ι (fun N : ModuleCat.{u} (AdicCompletion I A) ↦ Module.Finite (AdicCompletion I A) N) ⋙ ModuleCat.restrictScalars (algebraMap A (AdicCompletion I A)) ⋙ tilde.functor (CommRingCat.of A) ⋙ formalCompletionFunctor J)
lean.note: The equivalence carries limit cones, naturality, componentwise completed scalar action, and surjective projections with the specified ideal-power kernels. Its inverse is naturally the shared formalCompletionFunctor applied to tilde of the restricted completed module: on an affine this is the canonical tilde quotient system, including its reductions.
